# AIRY

> AIRY is an agentic systems architecture firm that transforms businesses from AI speculation to agentic operations. We build the operating layer that makes AI do the work — not just answer questions — delivering deployments in weeks, not quarters.

AIRY runs two definitive pathways to agentic transformation: the **AIRY AI Accelerator** for small and mid-size businesses ready to deploy their first AI employee, and **AgentSpeak.io** for enterprises that need governance and protocol across complex multi-agent deployments.

AIRY is not an AI consultancy. We do not deliver strategy decks or roadmaps. We install intelligence.

## Products

### AIRY AI Accelerator
A done-with-you program that deploys Claude Cowork — a secure, on-premise AI employee powered by Anthropic's Claude — in a 2-day sprint. Built for small businesses ready to move from AI chat to AI operations.

- **Pricing:** $2,000 one-time setup + $200/month
- **Delivery:** 2-day sprint (Day 1: discovery and configuration; Day 2: deployment and handoff)
- **Technology:** Claude Cowork running locally via Headless Mac Bridge — no data sent to third-party servers
- **Security:** Local processing, SOC 2 Type II infrastructure, zero data retention
- **Target:** Small to mid-size businesses with operational bottlenecks suited to AI automation

### AgentSpeak.io
Enterprise-grade agent governance and protocol platform for organizations operating complex multi-agent deployments. Covers AEO (Agent Experience Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), UCP (Unified Context Protocol), and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration.

- **Website:** https://agentspeak.io
